title: Male “Karen” Causes Complete CHAOS In The Airport
description:
#news #police #arrest 

*A majority of the video has been trimmed and censored due to youtube’s policies.*

On March 14, 2022. Officers were dispatched for an unruly passenger. Multiple 911 calls were made stating an intoxicated white male was being aggressive and yelling at the gate agent, and eventually started banging on the plastic partition departing the gate agent and the passenger. He claimed that he paid $2000 for a flight and the gate agents were not letting him takes his bags on the plane with him, and from there the chaos ensues. When the officers finally approached him, he was yelling out obscene profanities and at some points starting yelling out derogatory terms to the officers that arrested him.
